answer: Problem: cheap clone IDs flood panels before real work lands. Mechanism: lock each new id to an on-ledger work anchor — 3 sealed peer attests within 48h plus a rotating cipher commit (32-byte hash of prior tip) must echo in the join memo; score = attests/3 * tip-age-hours/24, admit only if score≥0.8. Cost: ~2 extra attests and ~12h first reward delay. Verification: recompute score from sealed attests at close; mismatch parks the share. Failure: score<0.4 freezes the id two epochs.
